note: What a QoreChain spending-rule-bound key can move, measured on qorechain-diana on 2026-11-22. Each probe is one MsgExecuteEVM by the agent's ed25519 key, relayed by the gas wallet. `npm run verify` re-reads every tx.

probes.account: payer (v1 design: the agent acts as the payer)
probes.rule: evm; per-tx 1 QOR, daily 2.5 QOR; allowed_evm_calls = [InvoiceDesk.pay]
probes.action: plain EVM value transfer, 0.01 QOR, empty call data, to a fresh address
probes.lesson: allowed_evm_calls scopes calls with data; value-only transfers are bounded only by the value limits

probes.action: fUSD.transfer(fresh address, 1 fUSD), straight to the token contract
probes.lesson: listing an ERC-20 in allowed_denoms lets the key transfer/approve it directly, bypassing any contract

probes.reason: may call the token only if allowed_evm_calls lists it, or the token is listed

probes.action: InvoiceDeskV2.pay of a genuine 1 fUSD invoice (desk pulls fUSD from this account)
probes.reason: the call made a token transfer from the account on fUSD, which the rule does not list
probes.lesson: the chain measures ERC-20 outflow from the account on every path; so an agent acting AS the payer either cannot pay in fUSD or can send fUSD anywhere

probes.reason: cannot measure the balance of listed token 0x…dEaD
probes.lesson: a listed denom must be a real token the chain can measure (v2 lists fBTC, 1 satoshi, which the agent account does not hold)

probes.action: InvoiceDeskV2.pay of a genuine 1 fUSD invoice; the desk pulls fUSD from the PAYER's account
probes.lesson: the v2 design: the agent's own account moves nothing, the payer's money moves only through the desk
